main.description: Apply a peer-moderation label to a post (community.blacksky.feed.post or app.bsky.feed.post).

subjectUri.description: AT URI of the post being labeled.

subjectCid.description: CID of the post version this label applies to.

reason.description: Optional explanation recorded with the Ozone event.

errors.name: PeerModRequired
errors.description: The caller does not hold the peer-moderator badge.

errors.name: InvalidSubject
errors.description: Subject is not a community.blacksky.feed.post or app.bsky.feed.post URI, is a permissioned-space record, or does not exist.

errors.name: OzoneFailed
errors.description: Ozone rejected the modEventLabel call; nothing was persisted.
